coverage.directory_note: All 9 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 33 source category filters (38 settled pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 207 native publisher listings; five facility records retained outside 202 business observations: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk and Woden Gardenland playground. Every uncategorised business detail was read: Pillow Talk explicitly sells bedding/furniture/decor and Tobacconist & Co tobacco/shisha; these descriptions support their categories. Source category combinations remain publisher classifications without presumed affinity or ownership. All native IDs retained, including two Big Barber, two Mister Minit, separately labelled Lovisa levels and St George versus Westpac & St.George; these are not assumed to be distinct occupied tenancies or collapsed without evidence. Five optical listings agree with the existing accepted census; census IDs, membership and stale-source flags remain unchanged. The owner roughly-224 specialty-store statement and older 239-tenant scale note use different dates/definitions from the live 207 listings and are not occupancy/completeness denominators. Existing source-attributed 72,800 m² scale note is retained without inventing a current measurement date. Phillip SA2 statistics describe residents, not the centre catchment. Owner over-529,000 total-trade-area population and 2025 expenditure estimates remain background because the relevant boundary map was not captured; its Sydney Metro comparison for Woden is a source inconsistency requiring clarification. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Reused live Westfield DOM extraction through every next-page control; all category filters joined by native store ID; every uncategorised listing received an official detail-page review.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic
coverage.research_status_label: Complete source capture within the stated research scope

evidence.public_note: Scale inferred from official portfolio GLA (72,800 sqm) and tenant count (239); not inferred from GLA alone

places.confidence: Partial public evidence; no commercial-success confidence inferred

Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Source listings may include upper floors, hotel or arcade units with explicit tenant street addresses; this is not a shopfront adjacency map. Missing businesses are unknown. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. Partial street evidence, not a premises census or verified current trading. Ranked Maps discovery is incomplete; association membership is not whole-street coverage. Unverified addresses and ambiguous services remain unknown. No absence inferred. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026.

coverage.directory_note: All 53/53 available publisher listings captured across both unfiltered A–Z pages, and all 53 linked detail pages reviewed uniformly on 2026-10-12. One atmX facility record covers two ATMs and remains outside the 52 tenant/business denominator. Source categories, including the publisher typo Profesional, are retained; General is not assigned a specific activity without explicit name/description evidence. Publisher categories may overlap or be broad (for example Cotton On is tagged Beauty); this capture reports the source rather than inferring brand affinity. Family-owned, franchised and national-chain wording is retained without inventing independent ownership. Open/Closed badges describe opening hours, not verified trading or permanent closure. The leasing page claims over 55 specialty retailers plus anchors, which does not reconcile with the 53 published records; the difference remains unresolved and is not treated as missing physical tenancies. The supplier Street financial-format label remains intact alongside the accepted physical Shopping Centre format. Existing OPSM/BrightEyes membership repairs and two accepted census outlets are reused unchanged. GLA remains unknown: an older planning-file size reference could not be retrieved and has no verified current definition/date. No Ballina Central property figures are borrowed. Resident-area context is not a measured centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Parsed publisher-rendered directory configuration and cards on both advertised pages; native IDs matched to all linked detail pages for full source taxonomy and explicit descriptions.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All 243 native directory IDs reconciled between both global arrays, complete shopping/food CMS cards and the rendered union of 196 shopping plus 59 food links. 240 usable business listings; two ATMs are facilities and Al Sultan Perfumery is explicitly coming soon. All available source descriptions were extracted uniformly; 42 are blank. 234 usable non-optical listings have conservative source-supported categories; original combined communication/electronics/games, music/DVD/books, liquor/tobacco and sport/fitness/outdoors labels remain combined. Source categories can be broad or inconsistent; raw categories are preserved, and BWS fresh-food tagging is overridden by its explicit drinks description. 6 directory optical listings are distinct from the unchanged two accepted census outlets; no proximity or new census mapping. Bupa generic corporate optical wording does not prove an optical store at this premises. Repeated Eastern Delights and Sushi Hub names retain distinct native IDs/URLs; USA Nails variants and car washes also stay separate, without claiming a verified physical-tenancy count. No independent ownership inferred; family ownership alone does not establish independence. Existing dated portfolio GLA reused; owner figures dated 31 December 2025 (78,575 m² GLA, 14.5m annual visits and 509,910 total trade-area population) do not supply a captured catchment boundary or traffic period/method. Forward-looking office/residential development and stale expected-completion language are not current completed-stock evidence. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Reused Vicinity structured-directory extraction; complete native store and category arrays; full published shopping/food cards; exact reconciliation against server-rendered links and live browser URL sets.

Explicit cinema wording additionally supports entertainment presence. Existing accepted iContact membership has current operator evidence from the prior repair but is omitted from this directory; omission does not establish closure. Sunglass Hut is a directory observation only, not an automatically promoted census member. GPT currently publishes 108100 square metres but does not state its measurement period on the property page. Resident-area figures are not catchment evidence, and Narellan/Ed.Square overlap remains unmeasured. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 102 primary directory cards and 17 category labels captured; every linked detail page fetched once with native WordPress ID, canonical URL and complete available description. One Flower Village alias redirects to the identical St Ives Flower Village post 1651 and is held, leaving 101 usable premises listings, 98 classified non-optical and three directory optical entries matching the unchanged accepted census. Published category combinations remain combined. Porter Liquor explicitly claims independently owned and operated; ownership is unknown for other tenants, and centre-level independent ownership is not assigned to them. MrK opening-soon URL slug is historical, with no current future flag in the title/description; hours do not verify trading. The currently linked map is visibly dated February 2026: 142 category rows collapse to 103 name/location records, including four unmatched dated businesses (R.M.Williams, Elm Lifestyle, Z&Y Cashmere and Silks, Ugg Express), two concessions inside Harris Farm and one concierge facility. R.M.Williams and Elm Lifestyle share shop 30 on the map, an unresolved source inconsistency. Map-only names remain unknown for current presence rather than promoted from older evidence; host detail explicitly supports the two Harris Farm concessions without counting extra standalone premises. Full live-directory coverage is not independent physical occupancy or current/historical trading verification. Size/GLA remains unknown. Leasing copy claims more than 6.6m yearly visitors without a reference year or method; it is not a comparable traffic measure or local catchment. Existing St Ives SA2 resident context and census stale-source warnings are retained unchanged. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete live directory shows 181 of 181 stores and matches all 181 unique native IDs/URLs in its page-published API. All 40 source categories retained; 29 source listings are uncategorised. Every linked detail page was captured once; five descriptions are blank. 173 classified non-optical listings and 6 optical directory entries, with unclassified businesses retained: Phone Mastermind, Mobile Pit. Dining Precinct is a location tag, not automatic food classification; all combined source categories remain combined. No independent ownership inferred from locally/Australian/family owned wording. Indian Beauty Secrets, KFC, Mobile Pit and Route 66 variants have distinct source IDs and SAP shop references; St George Bank and Westpac share one SAP reference, unresolved as physical tenancies. Civic childcare and library premises are included. All are publisher-listed only; no current or historical trading verification, and generic daily Closed now labels are not closure evidence. Six directory optics remain separate from four accepted census outlets. Existing source-attributed 63,870 m² GLA and 184 specialty-tenancy metric dated 30 June 2023 are reused, not new measurements or this directory coverage denominator. Greenfield Park–Prairiewood SA2 residents are background, not a centre catchment; no demographics or coordinates invented. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 10 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (38 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 228 publisher listings, with 4 facility records retained outside business observations: Concierge, gift card, prize collection desk and parcel locker. Australia Post and commercial Concierge Car Wash remain included. This is the accepted Burwood NSW centre directory, distinct from Burwood Plaza and Victorian Burwood destinations. Native store IDs and all published category memberships are preserved. Source categories can overlap or be broad; no presumed affinity or independent ownership is inferred. Transient partial renders and repeated checks are retained in raw evidence; only the settled full pagination enters comparison. Complete publisher enumeration is separate from verified individual trading and occupied physical tenancies. The dated compendium values of 63,200 m² GLA and 227 businesses are preserved as different measures and periods, not the current directory denominator. Eight optical directory listings include Sunglass Hut; the existing seven accepted census outlets remain unchanged. The previously repaired OWNDAYS membership is reused, and no new coordinate or competition membership is created. Burwood NSW resident-area context is not a measured centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Concierge Carwash is a business; parcel locker, concierge, gift-card/prize desks and recycling points are facilities. Two transient category loading states retained but excluded; settled recaptures used. Source product categories may overlap and Entertainment includes retail products as well as venues; counts do not measure leisure floor area or distinct tenancies. Independent ownership and individual trading unverified. The owner approximately 246 specialties and prior compendium tenancy figure differ from live published listings and are not extraction denominators. Existing attributed 83,000 sqm GLA retained with its date. Owner 2025 transaction-defined trade-area estimates and February 2026 webpage currency are background; boundary map not captured and local SA2 residents are not the catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 10 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 30 category filters (37 pages) captured. 235 native publisher listings; five facilities held separately: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk and recycling point. Sports and Spectators explicitly says Opening Soon on its detail page despite an unflagged directory card. Little Amigos is the sole uncategorised business; paid play supports Entertainment without inferring a separate food retailer from complimentary drinks. The Family Co is a described support-service premises, with undated opening text retained. All native IDs and source category combinations are preserved; independent ownership remains unknown. Seven directory optical listings are distinct from five unchanged accepted census outlets; OWNDAYS and Sunglass Hut require normal census review. Owner approximately 227 specialty stores and older 234-tenant note use different dates and definitions, not coverage denominators. Existing 61,000 m² source-attributed GLA is reused, not a new current measurement. Hurstville Central SA2 residents are not a centre catchment. Owner over-379,000 total-trade-area population and 2025 expenditure estimates remain background; transaction-defined boundary map was not captured and source metrics are current as February 2026. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 13 unfiltered A–Z pages and all 31 source category filters (39 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 290 native publisher listings, with five facility records retained outside the 285 business observations: concierge, gift card, prize collection desk, parcel locker and Bit Rocket crypto-ATM (explicit publisher detail description). Commercial car washes and Australia Post remain included. Source categories may overlap or be broad; no presumed affinity or ownership is inferred. Lovabra has no captured source category and remains unclassified. All native IDs are preserved, including separately listed floors of the same operator; source listings are not physical-tenancy counts or verified current trading. Raw transient category renders are retained but only settled URL/category pairs enter analysis. Eight directory optical listings match the existing accepted inventory; prior City Specs, Custom Eyes and Zoom repairs are reused rather than repeated. The 83,000 m² dated GLA evidence is retained, not treated as a current tenant denominator. Liverpool East resident-area figures are not a measured centre catchment; Ed.Square and surrounding Liverpool practices remain separate. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction through every visible next-page control; all published category filters joined by exact native store ID. Explicit ATM detail used to classify that facility separately.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All 17 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (45 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 398 publisher listings, including 5 non-tenant centre services retained but excluded from tenant observations. Same-name listings with different publisher IDs remain separate because distinct units have not been reconciled. Published category membership can be broad or surprising and is retained without brand-affinity overrides; this is publisher classification, not an independent activity audit. Category pages sometimes reset the dropdown display after pagination; classification follows the actual URL path linked from the verified first-page category, not the reset control or stale requested-category transport field. Transient empty loading captures are retained as raw evidence but are not empty-directory findings. All source IDs reconciled against the unfiltered list. Source counts are listings, not occupied physical tenancies. Earlier centre captures retain their original scopes; the five centre-service exclusions here must be considered when comparing listing/category shares. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 12 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (44 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 288 publisher listings, including 4 non-tenant centre services retained but excluded from tenant observations. Same-name listings with different publisher IDs remain separate because distinct units have not been reconciled. Published category membership can be broad or surprising and is retained without brand-affinity overrides; this is publisher classification, not an independent activity audit. Category pages sometimes reset the dropdown display after pagination; classification follows the actual URL path linked from the verified first-page category, not the reset control or stale requested-category transport field. Transient empty loading captures are retained as raw evidence but are not empty-directory findings. All source IDs reconciled against the unfiltered list. Source counts are listings, not occupied physical tenancies. Earlier centre captures retain their original scopes; the four facility exclusions here must be considered when comparing listing/category shares. Australia Post Parcel Locker is a facility, while the commercial Concierge Car Wash remains a service business. The publisher includes Borec House listings; these are explicitly directory-supported businesses, not proximity additions. Two City Optics source IDs are retained as unresolved related/duplicate listings and do not create an extra census store. Sunglass Hut K21 remains separate from any unverified Myer concession. Directory source categories are unusually broad in places, including one City Optics record under Food and drink; no activity claim is inferred beyond the optical listing role. Existing optical membership is unchanged. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix. Subsequent identity review: suspected duplicate publisher records are retained in held source history but excluded from tenant and optical listing counts. This supersedes earlier unresolved-duplicate wording; original captured totals remain unchanged.
coverage.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic
coverage.research_status_label: Complete source capture within the stated research scope

coverage.directory_note: Fixed numbered Bay Terrace/Wynnum study boundary was recorded before collection; explicit internal suites included, side streets and Manly excluded. Captured all 187 WynnumCentral listings through all 19 advertised pages, and all 32 mixed visitor-guide retail blocks without category/brand selection. Every WynnumCentral detail URL was attempted once; 182 succeeded and 5 timed out, retained without retries. Basic listings frequently expose only a name/category and no address. 20 business observations meet the fixed boundary; whole-street premises total and coverage percentage remain unknown. The sources are voluntary local publisher directories, not a council premises census; paid/free listing differences can bias address availability. Sobidah has conflicting Bay Terrace and Edith Street addresses and is held; the Health Hub Precinct and Manly Harbour Village are aggregate records held outside individual businesses. Simply Bella appears twice across publishers at the same address; both raw IDs retained with one observation. Some visitor entries have no precise activity category and remain unclassified. All retail sectors were considered, but absence of an in-scope category is unknown, never proof of absence. CMS dates and opening-hour tags do not verify current trading; several listings have old source modification dates. Current census Clacher and Hook membership and resident context are reused, with no new census points. No source-size or local shopper-catchment estimate is invented. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete advertised local directory pagination and uniform detail-page review; full visitor retail page; explicit address boundary and documented duplicate/conflict rules applied. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.

coverage.directory_note: Complete unfiltered official A–Z directory: 164 native store post IDs, each reconciled to its canonical detail URL; all 25 dining-directory URLs are included. Full descriptions captured uniformly, with JB Hi-Fi blank. 158 usable business listings; four ATMs plus JP and Police Beat retained as six facilities outside the business denominator. 151 classified non-optical and 7 directory optics remain separate from six accepted census outlets; directory Sunglass Hut does not silently create a census membership. Three listings have no source category (Allsorts Of Sweets, BWS and Liquorland), classified only by explicit descriptions. Mislabelled Flight Centre/Greg Lewis/iPlay, fresh-food-tagged dining outlets and beauty retailers are corrected from their captured descriptions while raw taxonomy is retained; Bupa insurance remains separate from Bupa Optical. Adairs independent-retailer marketing and family/local ownership do not establish independent-business ownership. Existing exact-listing categories reused without selecting tenants by brand affinity. Directory source count is not owner 172 tenants or over-170 marketing. Owner 51,972 GLAR and 73,080 site-area values lack stated units and measurement dates, so no square-metre value invented. Same leasing page reports 10.3m annual foot traffic and 9.5m annual visitors with no dates/method, so neither selected as current. $585m MAT and 3.7% expenditure growth to 2036 retain unknown period/boundary; growth is a forecast. Brochure contact form not submitted. Existing Cairns City SA2 data remain resident background, not the centre catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Captured all 185 available A–Z directory cards, every linked detail page and all 15 official category filters; exact unique native post IDs reconcile with URLs. No category-only extras or missing descriptions. 183 usable businesses, 176 classified non-optical and 7 optical directory listings; ATM and Police Beat remain facilities. Department/fashion/food/health/services and all small-business listings are covered uniformly. Combined books/stationery/gifts, entertainment/hobbies/activities, home/technology and broad health/fitness labels remain explicit. Only the arcade description establishes Timezone as a venue. Local/family ownership is not inferred as independent ownership. Seven accepted census optics remain unchanged: directory adds Sunglass Hut while describing Westfund as insurance, so equal counts do not imply identical inventories. Repeated related fascia and native IDs are source listings, not a verified physical-tenancy denominator. Homepage over 200 retailers, About over 180 and leasing 163 specialty stores differ from 185 available records; none overrides capture coverage. Previously attributed 65,864 m² GLA is retained with a caution that current page omits measurement date/unit; 7 December 2022 sale release reports 65,964 sqm centre area without explicitly defining GLA. These are unresolved measures, not evidence of 100 m² physical shrinkage. Undated 5.76m annual traffic and conflicting trade-area claims (155,030 December 2021,163,000+ undated,175,000+ service population in 2022;178,980 forecast 2036) are not current comparable catchment measures. Existing resident SA2 metrics remain background. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete server-rendered A–Z directory and all category archives, reconciled to every linked official detail page and stable WordPress post ID. Sequential one-attempt detail capture with pacing.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All 155 native IDs in both global directory arrays were captured; shopping/dining cards and server-rendered links cover 154 of them, with the extra Commonwealth Bank ATM retained from its explicit native detail page. Shopping and dining overlap by 4 IDs. 145 listed businesses enter presence; 10 facilities are retained separately. All available CMS descriptions extracted uniformly; 6 blank. 141 usable non-optical listings classified; 4 directory optical businesses remain distinct from the unchanged four accepted census outlets. Source taxonomy is broad and inconsistent: department stores and supermarkets receive health, beauty and services tags; optometry/health, health products/services, entertainment, travel goods/services, music/DVD/books and sport/fitness/outdoors categories remain explicitly broad or combined. A broad tag does not verify a clinical service or entertainment venue. BWS liquor classification follows its explicit bottle-shop description. No independent ownership is inferred; stocking independent brands does not establish independent ownership. Distinct native IDs for PTC, KFC and other variants are retained without claiming a verified physical-tenancy count. Reused GLA 53,190 m² is dated 31 December 2025. Owner 7.9m annual visits and 307,145 total trade-area population are dated context with no captured traffic period/method or catchment boundary; existing Browns Plains ABS SA2 population/income is resident-area context only. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Reused Vicinity structured-directory parser; all native arrays, full shopping/dining cards and rendered links reconciled, plus one native-only ATM detail.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: Complete primary directory:216 unique retailer URLs and all13 advertised category labels;19 raw slugs include six retailer-specific values not in the category menu. All216 linked profiles were attempted uniformly:137 usable HTML responses, one empty HTTP200 body for Bunnings, and78 HTTP429 responses. No retries were made after the bounded extraction. This establishes complete directory-card enumeration, not complete description/status verification. Gong Cha and Lan Spa are explicitly coming/opening soon; Chipmunks advertises opening16May without a year and stays unresolved rather than assumed already trading. JP and Police Beat service facilities are held outside the business denominator. BCF is held because its Hyperdome directory membership conflicts with profile text naming Domain Central Townsville. This leaves210 usable publisher business listings,199 classified non-optical,6 directory optics and5 unclassified non-optical listings (Miss Runway Boutique, Ollies Place, RSEA Safety, RSPCA, Supercheap Auto). The source has26 Home Centre-tagged entries; this scope is included explicitly but is not a separate surveyed property boundary. Broad entertainment and health/fitness tags include goods retailers and remain labelled as broad source categories. A missing profile may contain an unseen future-opening/status qualifier; unverified listings are not independent trading confirmations. Independent ownership remains unknown. Existing five accepted optical census entries and stale source dates stay unchanged; directory Sunglass Hut and published optical fascia variants do not silently alter the public census. Existing source-attributed72,374m² GLA and180-store portfolio claim are reused as property context, with underlying measurement period and reconciliation to the wider216-card directory unresolved. Shailer Park SA2 data is residential context from an authoritative point query, not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete live directory/API reconciliation: 108 of 108 native listings; every detail page captured once. 107 enter presence; Prouds remains held because its description names Stockland Rockhampton despite the Hervey Bay directory and SAP location reference. 104 usable non-optical records classified and 3 directory optical aliases, distinct from unchanged accepted census. 4 descriptions blank; no missing activity or trading status invented. Combined pharmacy/cosmetics, fresh-food/liquor, services/medical and broad entertainment taxonomy remain labelled; only explicit Timezone arcade/laser-tag activity establishes an entertainment venue. Sport First explicitly states all stores independently owned; this supports the source ownership claim but not absence of other independents. Hervey Bay Travel and Transit Centre is explicitly a travel booking business at the bus interchange and is included. Official FY25-branded leasing factsheet explicitly labels 36,851 m² as GLA, with information accurate as at 30 June 2024. The internal date controls rather than the FY25 filename. This dated measure fills an unknown field; no current measurement or silent queue reorder. Leasing sheet dated 30 June 2024 reports 99 specialty stores under its own less-than-400m² definition, not a directory denominator. Its 4.87m MAT traffic is historical with measurement method unknown. Trade-area map and demographics are dated July 2022/ABS2021: 107,700 is 2022 population, 112,700 a 2026 forecast, and $74,309 average annual household income is not resident-SA2 median income. None is relabelled a measured 2026 shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete official live directory/API reconciliation: 171 of 171 native listings; every linked detail captured once. 171 usable listings, 164 classified non-optical and 7 directory optical records; five accepted census outlets remain unchanged, with stale flags separate. OPSM and Sunglass Hut directory evidence does not silently add census memberships. Four repeated fascias (Amplifon, Casphone, ETUP and Priceline) have distinct native IDs and SAP references; Casphone explicitly describes a second store. Kmart and MyCar share one SAP reference but distinct business activities and IDs; the denominator is publisher business listings, not verified occupied tenancies. coverage.directory_note: All 142 official directory cards and linked details captured with unique native Drupal node IDs; 20 populated category groups and two additional empty filter options checked. Published map has 145 rows, including five unnamed units that remain raw background, not invented tenants. One map-only ATM is retained, giving 143 captured named records. 139 usable business listings, 133 classified non-optical and 6 optical directory listings. Police Beat, Money Link ATM and the second identical Myer record are held separately. Income Tax Professionals explicitly temporarily closed, retained but not present. Two Myer URLs have identical description/contact and one mapped anchor; raw IDs and duplicate crosswalk retained. Map combines EB Games/ZiNG while directory has separate fascias; listing denominator is not verified unique physical tenancies. Old map slugs, misdirected Crown Currency and inconsistent Wara Sushi links are preserved as discrepancies, not grounds for invented trading status. Reused logos with other-centre alt text do not override explicit local directory membership. Combined categories remain labelled; sporting-products retailer rebel is not classified as an entertainment venue. Independent brand ranges, local and family ownership are not independent-business ownership evidence. Six directory optics do not silently replace three accepted census optics. GLA 44,982 m², site area 94,126 m², parking 2,263 and 150-specialty claim are undated; site area is not GLA and marketing count is not directory coverage. Aitkenvale resident SA2 is not a catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete official directory: 198 unique native IDs over 9 unfiltered pages, plus every one of 32 category filters and 37 category pages. Each advertised pagination link captured once; last pages have no next link; category URL/title and filtered cards verified (server select HTML keeps empty default). Four centre facilities retained outside business counts, leaving 194 usable listings and 187 classified non-optical, with 7 directory optical listings separate from five unchanged accepted census outlets. Sunglass Hut and The Optical Superstore directory evidence do not silently add census memberships. Eight initial detail reviews cover both uncategorised entries, facilities and repeated All Around Massage premises; fourteen further details cover the entire broad entertainment filter, liquor/therapy/service ambiguities and optical aliases. NK Fashion explicitly describes youth fashion. All Around Massage and Mister Minit variants have separate source IDs and explicit different locations. Broad entertainment includes product retailers: only Reading Cinemas gains the specific venue category; Kumon is education and Lollipop Collective baby/child product retail. Dan Murphy and Liquorland remain liquor, not grocery observations. Kid Sense is an evidenced therapy business; Bupa Health retains broad source classification and stays separate from Bupa Optical. Independent ownership remains unknown; local small-business wording is insufficient. Other combined categories retain their source scope; individual unreviewed details and all trading remain unverified. Existing 71,400 m² GLA, 216 tenants and 7.1m annual visits are reused dated portfolio evidence, not fresh measurements or extraction denominators. Owner webpage February 2026 uses 2025 population/expenditure estimates (over 226,000 total-trade-area residents, $4.0bn total/$3.1bn main expenditure) with transaction-defined scope; boundary map unavailable and never replaced by West Lakes SA2 resident data. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Reused Westfield native-ID/category crosswalk; complete server-rendered pagination and category routes, with 22 focused detail checks for uniform taxonomy/facility review.

coverage.directory_note: Complete primary live directory: 87 unique published store IDs and all 87 rendered listing URLs agree, including shopping, dining and services; final No Stores Remain marker observed. Complete secondary map table has 83 non-empty rows, retained separately with aliases and source row IDs rather than counted twice. Platinum Spinal Centre appears only on that map, shares 94B with Kingston Chiropractic Solutions, and remains currency-unresolved rather than counted present. Live directory records may share suites (Services Australia, Medicare and Service Tasmania at 87A), and Tai Chi lists two shops under one record; listing counts are not occupied-tenancy counts. All 85 non-optical records have source-supported categories; Fresh Food & Liquor is retained as a combined label and only explicit grocery/liquor descriptions add narrower categories. No independent ownership is inferred from names or presumed brand fit; two descriptions explicitly state independently owned. Hobart Eye Surgeons is a health service, not assumed to be an optical retail store. Two optical directory listings are separate from the unchanged one accepted census outlet; Specsavers mapping to the wider Channel Highway corridor is not silently reassigned. Source descriptions and names sometimes contain template text, spelling errors or possible copy errors (Natures Works); original content retained. Brochure July 2024 retail GLA 25,274 m² is dated source evidence, not a current survey; its 3M annual traffic period/method and trade-area boundary are unspecified. Brochure demographics sourced to ABS 2021/Gap Maps remain unjoined background, distinct from the existing Kingston–Huntingfield SA2 resident figures. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete published WordPress store collection with total/page headers, full category taxonomy, and exact URL reconciliation to the all-category live directory; separate complete HTML map-list crosswalk.

Complete publisher capture is not whole-street census coverage; no street premises total, vacancies or absence inferred. Full retail/food/services/health/entertainment/fashion/beauty scope used uniformly. Readings is explicitly described as an independent Australian retailer; chain-level claim retained, outlet ownership still unknown under existing feature standard. Source scope/classification is not verified trading. St Kilda–West resident-area statistics retained as context, not a measured shopper catchment; no current GLA or footfall established. Sources observed 18–19 October 2026.

coverage.directory_note: Captured all 280 native trader cards across every published category on the council-endorsed association archive, with no directory pagination link in the source. 198 records have explicit numbered Bay Street / Port Melbourne addresses; other roads and one missing address are held. Entire association-directory capture is distinct from an unverified census of Bay Street premises: publisher membership, omissions, vacancies, duplicate occupied units and all individual trading dates are unknown. Upper-floor services are included as listed businesses, not claimed ground-floor shopfronts. Independent ownership remains unknown. No absence claims are made. Existing optical census membership and stale-source warnings remain separate from this fresh directory observation. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.

coverage.directory_note: Captured all 337 published records and 115 category terms from the independent Visit South Melbourne guide, plus all 12 available association records. 59 observations meet the predeclared numbered Clarendon Street / South Melbourne boundary after address, aggregate-property, facility and cross-publisher overlap holds. The independent guide is not an official council directory; the association directory is participation-based. Full publisher extraction is not full street-premises coverage. Internal addressed premises are included but not asserted to have street-level frontage. Missing source-locality text on association records is supported only by its explicit South Melb. Traders tag. The Mirror Mirror locality/postcode conflict remains held; Tesla charging facility and the aggregate Clarendon Centre property are excluded from business counts, and its category tags do not establish individual supermarket tenants. Seven cross-publisher overlaps are held, with native IDs and reasons retained; Chill Sports unit/range remains unresolved. CMS publish, expiry, never-expired, research-status and modification fields are not trading verification. Category shares describe these publishers’ selected listings, not the whole street, and must not be compared directly with complete centre inventories. Unlisted brands, current trading, historical co-tenants, independent ownership and true premises denominator remain unknown. Existing three accepted optical outlets are retained separately; their omission from these publisher lists is not absence or closure. Reused SA2 resident figures are not street shopper catchment or demand. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete published CMS pagination for both publicly accessible directories, preserving native IDs, source addresses and taxonomies; apply one predeclared literal street boundary and explicit overlap holds. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: The Show Me corpus contains 1,334 rows across 22 broad categories, but its homepage still foregrounds COVID restrictions and individual update dates are absent. It remains historical discovery evidence. Of 73 syntactically numbered street leads, five have newer corresponding profiles and 68 have unresolved currency; six other street-named records lack street numbers and one has malformed number104106. The current business network publishes71 structured profiles across all three pages and an interim119-name roster:48 roster entries reconcile to profile IDs and71 retain no addressed profile. All71 profiles were read uniformly, supporting one numbered Maude Street entry. The council visitor source yielded172 unique IDs from463 card appearances across43 captured listing pages, including page-one aliases, across all See & Do and Eat & Drink listing sections and their pagination; eight addressed street profiles were read in full. Tourist-promotion eligibility and association membership are selective, so these nine supported listings are not a representative retail mix and do not cover every supermarket, service, health business or independent. Published categories are preserved; ownership is unknown unless explicitly stated. No absence is inferred. Existing two optical census memberships and stale source dates are unchanged; Specsavers source is used only to resolve street identity. Existing Shepparton-North SA2 resident data is broader generalised-polygon context, not a measured shopper catchment. Tourism brochure counts describing the whole region are not used as a street denominator. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Full legacy directory; complete current published membership API and all profiles; council visitor business/activity categories with complete discovered pagination, native-ID deduplication and full review of every addressed street profile. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All 123 published association records across 14 pages and all 123 detail pages captured once, across all five source categories. The fixed numbered Racecourse Road boundary was saved before collection. 78 usable observations (78 classified non-optical) are business-listing evidence, not a unique occupied-premises count or verification of current trading. The directory includes side streets, addressed Newmarket Plaza shops, upper-floor services and public facilities; side streets and missing/conflicting addresses are held. Three evidenced aliases count once; an additional possible butcher alias stays held. Different named operators at shared premises remain separate published observations with succession/co-occupancy unknown. Two future and two temporarily closed source records do not count as present. Acher Pharmacy and Tiger Bread address conflicts remain held. Kensington Lawyers resolves to 301A through its own directory description. Source categories are broad and sometimes wrong: explicit business activities override grocery/retail tags for takeaway, liquor and a product supplier. Cellarbrations and Foodworks explicitly describe independently owned stores; other ownership remains unknown. Image publication timestamps are not business-status dates. Source geo points are retained only in raw evidence, not promoted as place coordinates or optical memberships. Whole-street population and coverage percentage are unknown, and no absence is inferred. Size and local-catchment demographics remain unknown; council special-rate finances are not retail scale. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Captured all 561 published association member IDs through six API pages with reconciled totals and all 85 business categories plus 12 membership types. All 32 advertised HTML pages yielded 561 cards but only 360 distinct IDs, with 201 repeated occurrences and 201 missing IDs: page coverage was not record completeness. Every missing profile and every potentially Sturt-addressed HTML card was checked uniformly: 236 successful profile captures. 39 observations qualify conservatively within the fixed street scope, 37 classified non-optical and no directory optical records. Three outer-street records remain suburb-boundary unknown even after operator checks; The Park Hotel is explicitly Alfredton and The Forge identifies its Alfredton branch. Two postcode3354 conflicts, a Ballarat Central/Melbourne field conflict, side streets, other localities and missing addresses remain held. Generic Ballarat postal/city labels are not independently surveyed suburb or frontage boundaries. The association is not an address-complete street inventory, so whole-street denominator and all missing-feature absences remain unknown. Schools, offices, community organisations, internal units and upper floors are included where the scope is supported; records are not unique ground-floor tenancies. Source taxonomy has demonstrable errors: health labels on a pub and Cellars, trades/manufacturing on a bakery, and tourism on a retailer. Raw taxonomy retained; explicit descriptions/activity names used conservatively, otherwise category unknown. Blue Illusion and Midtown Cellars remain unclassified. Current independent ownership is unverified; local/family ownership and a historical buying-group account are not treated as proof. Existing two optical census memberships and dates remain unchanged. Sturt Optical operator page confirms Ballarat but conflicts between731 and732; exact unit not resolved. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete published association native-ID index plus all advertised HTML pages, uniform missing-profile and potential-street profile checks, conservative address and category exception review. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.

coverage.directory_note: All 145 currently published association trader records captured: unfiltered HTML and live browser count reconcile exactly by native ID to two public API pages and the reported total. All 87 taxonomy terms captured; source category IDs and CMS dates retained. Every detail was attempted once: 140 HTML pages succeeded and five failed requests were recovered in one normal-browser fallback. 106 explicitly addressed Toorak Road/Toorak observations qualify, 104 classified non-optical and two directory optics. Side-street premises and two unpublished addresses are held; source status publish and opening hours do not verify trading. Village Vet has an explicit Toorak Road unit address but entrance via Tintern Avenue; internal arcades and upper floors qualify without asserting street frontage. The association directory is not a complete named-street register and its 200+ wider-village promotional count is not this study denominator. Six in-scope businesses are explicitly described as independent by the publisher; this is a source claim, not verified legal ownership. Independent buyer representation or personal independence is not treated as ownership. Existing accepted George and Matilda census membership and stale source date are unchanged; A&G Optique is directory evidence only, and side-street Trak Spex stays outside the study. Historical legacy directory search results are not merged into current presence; omissions do not establish closures. Existing Toorak SA2 resident context is broader generalised-polygon background, not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete current association HTML and advertised public WordPress trader API; native-ID, category and page-total reconciliation; every available detail address with one browser fallback for failed requests; fixed named-street boundary. coverage.directory_note: All 98 primary directory records, every linked detail page and all 15 category views captured. Native WordPress IDs reconcile uniquely; all category listings are within the primary directory. Two facilities (ATM and Myki top-up) are held, leaving 96 usable publisher business observations: 89 classified non-optical, 4 directory optics, and 3 non-optical category unknowns (Dangerfield, Dusk, Neverland). The two Tai Chi Massage native IDs have different unit references and remain distinct publisher observations without verification of simultaneous trading. The full interactive map has 99 labels, legacy links, conflicting units, two vacancy labels and a map-only Market News listing; none establish additional current trading or closure. A Bonds map label incorrectly links to Big W, and several directory-card unit links disagree with detail pages. All raw references and holds are retained; this is complete primary-directory extraction, not verified physical tenancy completeness. Category combinations remain combined; independent ownership remains unknown. The existing three accepted optical census stores and stale source dates are unchanged; the additional Sunglass Hut directory listing does not silently alter the public census. GLA 18,552 sqm is attributed to the manager at 30 June 2026; promotional 95+/100+ retailer claims are not directory denominators. Resident SA2 context remains broader display-polygon background; forecast growth and promotional regional reach are not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete official unfiltered HTML directory, all category pages and all native-ID detail pages; full interactive-map payload reconciled separately without treating stale links as current tenants.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic
coverage.research_status_label: Complete source capture within the stated research scope

coverage.directory_note: All 7 unfiltered pages and all 30 official category filters (33 pages) captured, with native-ID and pagination checks. 154 published listings include seven non-tenant facilities: parcel locker, concierge, gift card, prize desk, Giftmas concierge zone, recycling point and EV charging station. 147 usable business/service observations include 144 classified non-optical listings and three optical listings matching the unchanged accepted census. Both otherwise uncategorised Lucky Charm records explicitly describe newsagency franchises, with distinct centre locations and phone numbers; Pokero also has two explicitly different locations with separate IDs and shared phone. These are publisher premises observations, not verified occupancy. All eight detail checks and source categories retained; category combinations are not split into assumed activities. The older 160-tenant compendium figure and owner 149+ specialties use different dates/definitions, not extraction denominators. Reused attributed GLA 52,900 sqm is not a new current measurement. Owner population about 397,000 and retail expenditure estimates refer to 2025 transaction-defined trade areas, with webpage currency February 2026; trade-area map was not captured. Existing Airport West SA2 residents are not that catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Complete live Westfield DOM pagination and every published category filter, joined by native publisher ID; otherwise uncategorised listings and suspected facilities reviewed on their official detail pages.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

evidence.public_note: Scale inferred from official portfolio GLA (52,900 sqm) and tenant count (160); not inferred from GLA alone

coverage.directory_note: All 14 live unfiltered A–Z pages and all 32 published category filters (43 pages) captured on 2026-10-12. 328 publisher listings, with 5 facility records retained outside tenant/business observations. Directory enumeration is not independently verified physical tenancy occupancy or current trading. Category membership is the publisher’s classification and can be broad, surprising or incomplete; no brand-affinity overrides are applied. The two Concierge IDs, gift card, prize collection desk and parcel locker are facilities. Listed community, professional, education and health services remain included. Gumnuts Playland is a named operator with booking, café and party services on its official detail page and is not presumed to be a centre amenity. Knox Library is a listed community service; no unsupported source category is supplied. Distinct publisher IDs and same-name listings are retained; these are not necessarily distinct reconciled premises. Source category page URLs and actual selected controls establish classification, not a stale requested-category transport label; blank dropdowns on paginated pages are resolved from their visible next-page links. Transient empty renders are preserved and do not establish absence. The dated compendium value of 376 businesses and 141,400 m² GLA remain separate source-attributed measures, not the current directory denominator. Existing seven accepted optical outlets are unchanged; eight optical directory listings include Sunglass Hut without automatically adding another census point. Prior Optimax Knox repair is reused, retaining the distinction from Burwood NSW. The Wantirna South resident-area data are not a measured shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Read-only live browser DOM extraction, following each visible next-page control through terminal page. Stable store identifiers preserved; every published category filter captured and joined by publisher ID.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All nine unfiltered A–Z pages (193 unique IDs) and all 31 category filters (36 settled pages) captured. Four facilities held, leaving 189 usable source business/service listings and 186 classified non-optical observations. Three directory optics match the unchanged accepted census. Transient empty/mislabelled category states are retained raw and excluded by URL/label reconciliation. An earlier Home filter exposed one additional native ID, 6KoseM83cBi9rnbbU49tLy, absent from A–Z and the later live 22-card Home recheck; this publisher/hydration discrepancy remains unresolved without inventing its identity. Broad categories describe publisher tagging, not verified principal activity; Baby Bunting Childcare tagging does not establish a childcare service, and two liquor stores are classified from explicit details. Bottlemart expressly claims independent ownership; other ownership unknown. Detail review covers all unclassified/facility and identified duplicate/category anomalies, not an ownership census. New Spicy grocery variants have different contact/location details and remain separate source IDs; BWS is described inside Woolworths. Existing 63,400 m² portfolio GLA with source date 24 February 2026 is reused, not a new measurement; 185 portfolio tenancies are not the directory coverage denominator. Mill Park–North SA2 residents are not a centre catchment. No new coordinates, demographics or optical memberships. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Reused complete live Westfield DOM pagination and every category filter, joined by native store ID. Reconciled settled URL/label states, reviewed all uncategorised/facility records plus category and duplicate anomalies.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

Historical owner GLA is reused with its 31 December 2025 date. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete current A–Z directory: 115 official records, all native taxonomy IDs and full profiles reviewed. Centre Management is a facility hold; 114 business listings enter presence, including 19 explicitly tagged office businesses. 110 classified non-optical listings and 4 optical directory observations; two accepted census outlets remain unchanged. Official scope includes indoor centre, Maki Street/Town Square and offices; do not compare listing composition with indoor retail-only directories as equivalent occupied-tenancy samples. No neighbouring Westgate properties inferred. Older Maki/promotional pages name additional historical retailers not in the current index; these are not promoted. Linked December 2025 PDF exceeded the capture size cap and was not reviewed; current HTML profiles are complete. Source category Travel & Leisure includes a gym, arcade and musical-instrument retailer, classified by actual described activity. Independent non-optical ownership remains unknown; explicit independent Westgate optometry is recorded separately. Complete directory capture does not verify trading or current occupied units. Approximate 32,500 m² GLA is explicitly stage 1+2 scope but source/measurement date unknown; 2026-09-02 was an earlier verification date. Approximate 475,000 within a 15-minute drive is undated with no model/boundary, not a comparable resident or shopper catchment. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete current indexes: 83 shop plus 22 dining profiles, both paginated to first empty response, 105 unique native posts/full profiles. Five map-only business labels retained as unresolved holds; with these the evidence denominator is 110 records. BNZ is an ATM-only facility hold. 104 usable business listings, 102 classified non-optical and two optical directory observations; accepted census remains one Specsavers outlet. Includes open-air retail and Lifestyle Centre as explicitly published, not an indoor-only sample. Travelex is inside House of Travel and Warehouse Stationery is within The Warehouse; listing counts are not distinct occupied premises. Five map-only businesses (Barkers, Relax, Phone Life, Farmer Auto Village, Early Settler) remain unknown; Barkers profile 404 is not proof of closure. Map has old links, repeated IDs and incorrect categories (PAK’nSAVE tagged health/beauty); full profile activity takes precedence. The Phone Shop description is blank; name supports technology retail only. Independent ownership directly supported for The Crossing Pharmacy; family/local/network descriptions elsewhere do not prove local independence. Current GLA and comparable catchment unknown. Undated claim of just over 350,000 total trade area lacks year/model/boundary. Linked 2025 brochure exceeds the 6 MB capture cap and the web parser limit, so not reviewed; historical development schedule not presumed completed. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: Both full public paginated indexes and all linked full profiles with native WordPress IDs, supplemented by explicitly held map-only business labels; all raw map labels retained for audit.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

coverage.directory_note: All 269 published profiles across Shop 118, Dine 42, Services 93, Stay 6 and Explore 10 captured once; no pagination links. Native WordPress IDs, raw slugs, categories and literal addresses retained. Map markers reconcile to profile names but dining/services maps show only 11/42 and 10/93; map pins alone would severely undercount. 141 in-scope current directory listings; 128 side-street/address/facility holds. Royal Arcade interiors excluded, including a studio whose promotional summary loosely calls its arcade address Stafford Street. Hallensteins explicit Stafford/Church corner included. Postal kiosk inside Acquisitions held separately. Repeated galleries, Cyclery retail/hire and related Hobby Lords/Mana & Meeples cafe retain separate native IDs with explicit relationship notes, not assumed distinct occupied premises. Upper-floor offices and hosted health practices are included as addressed businesses. 22 in-scope profiles have blank narrative descriptions but retain source categories; classifications do not prove current trading. Hobby Lords current heading supersedes old dated-opening URL. Rebel Sports source department-store tag corrected by explicit sporting-goods activity; broad Sports/Recreation and art/product categories do not automatically imply an entertainment venue. Independent ownership unknown. Full available association directory does not establish full Stafford Street coverage, vacancies or absence. No supermarket absence, optical census, coordinate, GLA or local catchment inferred. Existing Elizabeth Street Specsavers and Canon Street optical listing remain outside scope. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
coverage.capture_method: All full publisher section cards and every linked detail profile; embedded map-name reconciliation; explicit street-address filter declared before collection. Explicit professional-office source categories redacted to count-only samples; original records and IDs retained in the private research archive.
coverage.ownership_coverage: Unknown except explicit source statements; no chain-name heuristic

Six facilities, one management office and the monthly outdoor market remain eight scope holds; 45 permanent business/service listings are usable and classified. Full directory coverage is not verified occupied-premises coverage or current trading. East/West scope includes separately owned Woolworths, The Warehouse, Noel Leeming and Plus Fitness by explicit publisher membership, not shared ownership. Woolworths profile explicitly reconciles old Countdown map label. Warehouse Stationery and The Warehouse separate profiles need not be distinct standalone premises. Viva la Moda product-range COMING SOON text is not a future store flag. Retail products and generic bookable events do not automatically establish an entertainment venue; independent local ownership remains unknown. Current GLA and comparable catchment unavailable; district marketing, historical management charts and unrelated office sizes are not substitutes. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: All 67 A–Z profiles captured and reconciled to all 67 centre-map entries; Shop 48 and Eat/Drink 22 overlap to the same 67 unique URLs, with no pagination or load-more control. Complete scope includes upper-floor offices, health and service businesses. Explicit shop IDs, levels, URL slugs and modified timestamps retained; page updates/opening hours do not verify current trading. Pavilion and three food concepts share E-01, while Barkers/Max share D-04; source listing totals are not distinct premises. Iron + Ivy index alias resolves to Iron and Ivy Hair Studio. Source taxonomy is broad; all full descriptions reviewed with activity-specific corrections. Adventure product retail and incidental board games at a restaurant do not establish an entertainment venue. Independent ownership unknown. Two directory optical profiles vs one accepted census record are separate evidence, with no silent census promotion. Leasing page describes retail/recreation/commercial development and a next stage but supplies no defined current GLA, occupied-unit denominator or shopper catchment. Adjacent Five Mile/Remarkables Park excluded. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

Explicit shop IDs, levels, URL slugs and modified timestamps retained; page updates/opening hours do not verify current trading. Leasing page describes retail/recreation/commercial development and a next stage but supplies no defined current GLA, occupied-unit denominator or shopper catchment. Adjacent Five Mile/Remarkables Park excluded. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete available Shop and Dine indexes: 44 linked full profiles plus Balibu’s unlinked logo listing, 45 usable business records. Four map-only names remain held: EB Games, Westpac, Otto’s Corner Store and Geobyte. The latter three are within a separately labelled 25 Esk Street map block; no current mall membership inferred. Evidence denominator 49 includes those four holds. Six unlinked shop tiles are category headings and Esk Eats is a precinct logo, not extra tenants. Ten image filenames say COMING SOON but visually inspected tiles do not; full current profiles lack future flags. Native Squarespace collection and index-block IDs retained. Mister Mint meta typo resolved to visible Mister Minit. Barkers/Max share one mapped unit; combined Sushi & Bento/Noodle Noodle profile covers two labels. Counts are source businesses, not occupied tenancies. Balibu has no detailed profile or hours. Independent ownership unknown; no optical listings found in directory but parent census scope is unverified, so no optical absence asserted and neighbouring corridor records remain unchanged. Current GLA/catchment unknown; historical 2022 constructed area includes atriums/amenities and staged plans, not current GLA. Undated advertising claim over 30,000 weekly visitors is not measured annual footfall. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.

coverage.directory_note: Complete publisher directory: 104 native post records, full embedded profiles in two identical arrays, reconciled against 104 unique rendered directory URLs. 96 usable business listings, including 8 office businesses; 94 classified non-optical and 2 optical directory records. Five advertised vacancies and two coming-soon listings are non-present; centre management is a facility hold. Current titles take precedence over historical slugs such as eb-games (Acai Era coming soon), the-body-shop (vacancy), vacant (Pandora), for-lease (Platypus), and bnz-opening-soon (current BNZ listing). All source IDs and slugs retained. Shared map-unit IDs are publisher inconsistencies, not proven duplicate businesses or occupancy. No independently owned non-optical business established; Welly Collective represents one listing, not 140 separate tenant records. Full directory coverage does not verify trading. Office-inclusive composition is not equivalent to retail-only directories. New World appears in parking directions, not the tenant directory; membership is not inferred and its absence remains unknown. Older Body Shop references are not promoted. Owner tenancy components are undated and may overlap; no whole-centre GLA or defined catchment established. Savills 48.20 m² is one office unit, not centre GLA. Directory capture does not independently establish current trading, occupied premises or historical retail mix.
